candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care, p. 21 — Collaboration with Multidisciplinary Team and Concepts of Management.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — multidisciplinary collaboration and continuity of care
candidate.educational_objective: Coordinate care by recognizing when multidisciplinary expertise is needed, communicating relevant information, collaborating with appropriate team members, and maintaining continuity across the plan of care.

options.A: Identify and collaborate with appropriate multidisciplinary team members, communicate relevant client information, and integrate the plan to support continuity of care
options.B: Develop the entire rehabilitation plan independently so the client receives a single-discipline plan without conflicting recommendations
options.C: Delay nursing care planning until another discipline assumes responsibility for the client's mobility and self-care needs
options.D: Ask the family to arrange outside rehabilitation services without first coordinating the need through the client's health care team

candidate.rationale: The 2026 NCSBN NCLEX-RN Test Plan identifies collaboration with the multidisciplinary team as Management of Care. RN activities include identifying and collaborating with appropriate team members, communicating significant information to other disciplines, reviewing the plan of care for continuity across disciplines, and acting as a liaison to coordinate care. Therefore A is the best answer. The RN should not replace other disciplines' expertise, defer the nursing plan while waiting for another discipline, or bypass the health care team's referral and coordination process.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The RN coordinates client care by identifying needed multidisciplinary expertise, communicating relevant information, collaborating with team members, and supporting continuity across disciplines.
candidate.source_locator: Management of Care, p. 21, Collaboration with Multidisciplinary Team: identify significant information to report to other disciplines; review plan of care to ensure continuity across disciplines; identify and collaborate with multidisciplinary team members when providing client care. Concepts of Management: identify roles/responsibilities and act as liaison to coordinate/manage care.
candidate.source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
candidate.stem: A hospitalized client has new mobility and self-care limitations that require expertise beyond the RN's independent nursing interventions. Which action best demonstrates appropriate management of care?
